StrongArm.a: Suitability for heavy work, including hauling, is beyond question.
StrongArm.b: In load testing, the test equipment reached its limit first.

EarlyBird.a: Work efficiency is high from the moment of waking.
EarlyBird.b: Attendance at morning assembly is consistently perfect.

NightOwl.a: Work efficiency is high at night.
NightOwl.b: Activity is logged after lights-out. The assigned working hours may not match actual practice.

MoleHands.b: Gloves must be ordered to measure.

Greasemonkey.a: Well versed in the handling of machinery.
Greasemonkey.b: Tends to adjust parts that were not assigned. Results have been broadly satisfactory.

Foodie.b: The largest contributor of canteen feedback forms.

BedsideManner.a: Attentive in the care of patients.
BedsideManner.b: Aptitude for nursing confirmed. No patient complaints on record.

CantResearch.a: Assignment to research departments is not recommended.
CantResearch.b: The "logic" field of the aptitude test is illegible due to ink bleed.

CantDig.a: Movement ceases in the presence of holes. Not eligible for mining duties.
CantDig.b: Three attempts to assign to mining are on record. All ended partway through.

CantCook.a: Strong distrust of cooking. Not eligible for kitchen duties.
CantCook.b: The officer who proposed a kitchen posting was reassigned the next day.

CantBuild.b: When advised to use a self-made chair, the subject politely declined.

Hemophobia.a: Not eligible for the care of the sick or injured.
Hemophobia.b: A detour is advisable whenever the route passes the infirmary.

Snorer.a: Sleeping volume exceeds the standard value for living quarters.
Snorer.b: Care is required in assigning neighboring rooms.

Narcolepsy.a: Sleeps on duty. Location is not a factor.
Narcolepsy.b: If work has stopped partway, it is sleep, not a malfunction.

MouthBreather.b: The oxygen bill is higher than that of other staff.

Flatulence.a: Exhaust frequency is high. Please consider ventilation.
Flatulence.b: Securing the upwind side is advisable at placement.

Claustrophobic.a: Uneasy in spaces under 4 tiles high or 3 tiles wide.
Claustrophobic.b: Confirm room dimensions at the design stage.

BingeEater.b: Advance notice to catering is required.

BalloonArtist.a: Hands out balloons when in good spirits.
BalloonArtist.b: The source of the balloons has not been confirmed.

DataRainer.a: Microchips fall when joy runs high.
DataRainer.b: Accounting is still discussing how to process them.

AncientKnowledge.a: Arrived with a set of skills already acquired.
AncientKnowledge.b: The origin of those skills was queried. No reply was received.

Chatty.a: Communicates smoothly. Suited to dealing with colleagues.
Chatty.b: Several cases are on record of another staff member getting an idea during small talk.

DiversLung.b: Aptitude for singing is also expected. No vacancy is planned.

DeeperDiversLungs.a: Breath-holding under water is especially good.
DeeperDiversLungs.b: Breathing was observed to have stopped. On inspection, the subject was perfectly well.

IronGut.a: Little affected by the sanitary state of meals.
IronGut.b: Treated as exempt from canteen hygiene inspections.

StrongImmuneSystem.b: Infirmary visits are almost absent from the record.

Meteorphile.b: When a shower is forecast, the window seats fill up.

FastLearner.b: Training materials are finished before they are distributed.

InteriorDecorator.a: Keen on improving the living environment.
InteriorDecorator.b: Furniture that was not ordered moved is found moved the next day.

SimpleTastes.a: Raises no complaint about the quality of meals.
SimpleTastes.b: The taste rating field is blank. There are no complaints either.

DecorUp.b: The standard-issue uniform becomes a different garment on this subject.

Thriver.b: Tends not to make a real effort until the deadline approaches.

GreenThumb.b: The subject has been seen talking to plants. No reply has been confirmed.

ConstructionUp.b: Completed facilities generally outlast their expected service life.

RanchingUp.b: Every animal on the ranch roster has been given a name.

Loner.b: Meeting attendance is optional. Absence has become routine.

StarryEyed.b: Cases are on record of the subject standing motionless before the viewing window.

GlowStick.a: Emission of light has been confirmed.
GlowStick.b: Convenient for searches in the dark. The subject's wishes have not been confirmed.

RadiationEater.b: Protective equipment was provided. The subject described it as "heavy".

FrostProof.a: No difficulty working in cold environments.
FrostProof.b: Has requested duty in the cold room. The reason is unclear.

Regeneration.b: Medical certificates are almost never needed.

SunnyDisposition.a: Optimistic, and helps keep those nearby in good spirits.
SunnyDisposition.b: No pessimistic report has ever been filed.

RockCrusher.b: The sound of rock being crushed carries to the office block.

ScaredyCat.a: Averse to violence. Participation in combat cannot be expected.
ScaredyCat.b: Absence notes for defense drills are carefully written every time.

ConstructionDown.a: Builds slowly and with low precision.
ConstructionDown.b: Completed facilities require re-inspection. Relationships with colleagues are being built well.

RanchingDown.b: Interviews with ranch animals have not been held, at the request of both parties.

CaringDown.b: No letter of thanks from a patient has arrived yet.

BotanistDown.a: Rough in the handling of plants.
BotanistDown.b: Please decline in advance if asked to look after a houseplant.

ArtDown.a: The finish of artistic work is inconsistent.
ArtDown.b: The subject titles their own works. No commentary is provided.

CookingDown.a: The quality of cooking is low.
CookingDown.b: Scorching was observed while preparing an ice dessert. The cause is under investigation.

MachineryDown.b: Wiring requests should be passed to someone else.

DiggingDown.b: The paper-bag escape test has not yet been carried out.

SlowLearner.b: The results of training were eventually confirmed. The subject's effort deserves recognition.

NoodleArms.a: Low arm strength. Not suited to carrying heavy loads.
NoodleArms.b: No case is on record of a load cooperating when lifted.

DecorDown.a: Appearance is untidy, which affects the surroundings.
DecorDown.b: A proposal to iron the uniform is being considered favorably.

Anemic.a: Lacks stamina. Endurance at work is low.
Anemic.b: Tends to fall behind partway through duties. Companions should match their pace.

IrritableBowel.a: Needs extra time for toilet use.
IrritableBowel.b: Restroom occupancy exceeds the standard estimate.

SmallBladder.b: Often leaves work partway. A post near a restroom is advisable.

CalorieBurner.a: Consumes a large amount of food.
CalorieBurner.b: Catering charges are booked as for several persons.

WeakImmuneSystem.b: A regular at the infirmary. No effect from vitamins has been confirmed.

Allergies.b: Avoid assigning to outdoor farms. The sneezing carries.

NightLight.a: Afraid of the dark. Needs a light on when sleeping.
NightLight.b: A proposal to switch the lights off did not obtain the subject's consent.

Uncultured.a: Shows little interest in the arts.
Uncultured.b: The art room's only visit on record was a case of getting lost.

PrefersWarmer.a: Low insulation, and more sensitive to room temperature.
PrefersWarmer.b: Disagreements over the temperature setting are on record.

PrefersColder.a: High insulation, and less affected by room temperature.
PrefersColder.b: At the subject's request, remarks on build are kept brief.

SensitiveFeet.a: Dislikes walking on bare bedrock. Tile must be laid.
SensitiveFeet.b: An application for shoes is pending. The review is proving difficult.

Fashionable.b: Has voluntarily submitted a proposal to revise the uniform.

Climacophobic.a: Dislikes ladders taller than four tiles.
Climacophobic.b: Check ladder heights at the design stage.

SolitarySleeper.b: Confirm the subject's wishes before assigning a shared room.

Aggressive.b: A repair budget has been set aside in the subject's name.

StressVomiter.b: Advance notice to cleaning staff is required.

UglyCrier.b: Check the effect on neighboring rooms in advance.

Banshee.b: Reports say it cannot be told apart from the alarm system.

SparkleStreaker.a: Runs leaving sparkles when in good spirits.
SparkleStreaker.b: Cleaning staff are struggling to collect the sparkles.

StickerBomber.a: Rearranges room decoration unasked when in good spirits.
StickerBomber.b: The source of the stickers has not been confirmed.

SuperProductive.a: Work efficiency rises greatly when in good spirits.
SuperProductive.b: Good-spirits days do not match the duty roster.

HappySinger.b: Complaints about singing volume are not accepted.

RoboDancer.a: Breaks into dance when in good spirits.
RoboDancer.b: Participation by companions is optional. In practice, they get swept in.

grantSkill: Already holds "{0}" at the time of assignment.
A "{0}" qualification was listed in the arrival paperwork. How it was obtained is unknown.
Reached the "{0}" level without training. The standing of the training department is a concern.
Capable of handling "{0}". The subject is awaiting an opportunity for promotion.

memos.Narcolepsy: A wake-up officer was appointed; few instances of the subject waking are on record.
memos.MoleHands: When shaking hands, do not be alarmed by their size.
memos.DataRainer: No one has counted what falls.
memos.CantResearch: Disposition is cheerful. This is a fact.
memos.Snorer: Earplugs are recommended for night patrols.
memos.Foodie: The suggestion box is always full.

genericMemos: Objections are not accepted. No counter has been installed.
No intention to resign has been confirmed.
Immediately after printing, everyone seems in good health.
Based on the record at printing. May differ from the subject's self-assessment.
